messages:
maya: Morning async — quick standup (what I did / blockers / today)
maya: Did: validated AMS1 GPU pool scale policy, drained 2 nodes for kernel patch, updated node labels for spot fallback.
maya: Blockers: seeing higher-than-expected reclaim on p4d-24; batch jobs getting queued, some pod preemptions. Might need temporary quota bump or routing change.
maya: Today: open PR with autoscaler tweak, coordinate with cloud for a temporary buffer, run a light surge canary at 11:30.

sam: saw the queued jobs, digging into scheduler logs now.
sam: found preemption spike at ~03:12 — logs show repeated PreemptedByHigherPriority events.
sam: log snippet:
sam: ```json
sam: {"pod":"inference-abc","reason":"PreemptedByHigherPriority","node":"gpunode-22"}
sam: ```
sam: I'll try a quick hotfix to lower priority of batch jobs and push a patched priority class.

jordan: filed cloud ticket 987324 (cc @cloud-support) asking for temporary quota bump. They want usage breakdown — linked in the ticket.
jordan: link: https://redwood.atlassian/issue/987324
jordan: if they need a commitment window we can propose a 6h scheduled buffer for the surge.

kai: FYI ran a canary on ded-bkt — latency within SLO, no regressions.
kai: also added a short-lived route rule to prefer a100 for batching while p4d headroom is low: `route:set batch->a100 if latency<180ms`.

ops-bot: autoscaler alert: scale-down inhibited 1h ago due to pending draining tasks (ID: sd-556).
ops-bot: follow-up: created ticket INF-231.

liam: quick ask — can we hold off on draining gpunode-24 until after the 11:30 canary? I have a rollout that needs stable nodes.
maya: ok +1 — rescheduling drain to 12:15.
maya: sam — can you own PR merge once cloud approves quota?
sam: yup, will merge after CI passes and canary is green. :thumbsup:

jordan: pinging infra-approvals for the temporary quota window now.
jordan: @kai can you add the surge config and the route fallback to the runbook?
kai: on it, will push a short PR in ~10m.

maya: summary: 
maya: - delay drain -> 12:15
maya: - sam: autoscaler PR + priority hotfix
maya: - jordan: cloud ticket + approvals
maya: - kai: runbook + route rule
maya: will post results after the 11:30 surge canary. Thanks — tag me if you hit blockers. :rocket:
